generalSettings.msg14: The number of days within which the Payee has to authorize the payment.
generalSettings.msg15: To eliminate duplicate payments, Payment Exchange will validate identical payment information within the pre-determined time period. The system will reject identical payments from processing in this determined time period. Based on your business needs if you do not need to reuse your payment reference ID's, our recommendation is 364 days for duplicate days option else 2 days.

generalSettings.msg18: If selected, payment will be sent through the default payment method after the authorization request has expired. If not selected, the payment will be rejected.
